description: LLM provider: chat.complete@1 with a deterministic in-sandbox SIMULATOR backend (every completion carries sim: true). The live openai-compatible leg is implemented but owner-machine-only: it requires config.live AND a credential.use capability that no in-sandbox composition grants. A live adapter tier would declare EXTERNAL_MUTATION for paid API usage (v2 policy refinement); the simulator is local, so chat.complete stays READ.

parser.doc: W1/T-04 harvest (D-355): the version-pinned SSE framing parser parser:chat.complete:llm — NOT routable (parser kind registers no op). The transform is pure and deterministic: recorded SSE stream text in, ordered ParsedChunk rows out (sse.frame / sse.delta*n / sse.done-final). Algorithm harvested from vivim-final-program@4a5eb84 src/engines/parsers/sse-parser.ts (73 lines, pure) with I/O re-expressed to M1 chunk rows; transport off, recorded fixtures only (fixtures/sse/), fail-closed on unterminated streams. Discovery-derived evidence trail: the fixture pipeline's recorded stream + the pin the realization carries.

capabilities.justification: The simulator is self-contained (no network, no secrets, no capabilities). A live adapter tier would request credential.use — a REFERENCE to a vault-held credential, never the secret itself; that tier is owner-machine only (docs/SURFACES.md credential law).
